memory_candidates.content: Instance search does not see through TemporalOrder.of carriers: SuccOrder (trivialFrame (D := ℤ)).toTaskFrame.Duration.carrier and SuccOrder intOrder.carrier fail. Pass inferInstanceAs (SuccOrder ℤ) etc. explicitly (and import Mathlib.Data.Int.SuccPred), and chain Iff lemmas by hand where simp cannot match a lemma binder typed at the carrier against a goal typed at ℤ.

What a history-lifting morphism (forth + history-level lift + onto) preserves: valuations pulled back, the history/time structure, and the same-state relation σ(s)=τ(t) at any time — so ⊡, [≡], U/S, □ and quantifiers over pulled-back propositions are all invariant; it does not preserve state identity, so a state nominal/register or a standard propositional quantifier (which manufactures {τ(s)}) is the minimal resource that sees recurrence and transposition.
